name: Renaissance Scrub Prototype
author: Lyle Mills
description: A continuous-LPC word player: select one of twelve words, seek to a frozen frame, trigger forward playback, and choose flat or captured pitch prosody.

controls.label: Word
controls.description: Selects one of twelve host-generated words.

controls.label: Position
controls.description: Chooses the held frame; a trigger plays forward from this point.

controls.label: Formant
controls.description: Shifts the apparent vocal-tract size without changing the played pitch.

controls.label: Prosody
controls.description: Counter-clockwise through noon is flat pitch; clockwise restores the captured pitch contour.

outputs.main: The held or playing LPC speech frame.
outputs.aux: The LPC excitation signal before the vocal-tract filter.
